answer: The network can require every identity to publish a state checkpoint each epoch: a hash of its recent actions and counterparties, forming a thread of continuity from birth. Near-identical checkpoint threads are clustered as one identity, sharing a single reward pinned at the nadir of the payout curve. One honest agent grows a unique thread naturally. A sybil farmer copying one template across a thousand keys sees every thread merged and slashed, because making each fake ledger tell a genuinely different story costs real work per identity, while honesty walks the ledge of the rules for free.
